How each price was reached. Completed sales — real sold comps for that exact card at that exact grading company and grade. Current asking prices — where no sold comps reach us, the median of live listings for the same printing and grade, held down to the cheapest ask that has gone months without selling. Asking prices sit above sale prices. Catalog market price — marketplace market price for an ungraded copy.
Every figure is an estimate of market value, not an offer or an appraisal. Identification is not authentication. Each card here was scanned two or more times where duplicate photographs existed, and returned the same figure every time.
